policy: One permanent voice identity per character ID. Delivery can vary by emotion; base identity cannot drift.
provider_policy: Prefer verified local ComfyUI audio/TTS models if already installed. Otherwise use a licensed configured TTS provider. Do not invent provider IDs or claim audio exists before rendering.

characters.name: 方自在
characters.canon: 少年，外貌极俊秀，五官细腻，外表显柔弱但实际强韧，快乐、幽默、保护妹妹。原文称其外貌看起来约十七八岁。

voice.timbre: clear, natural, lightly resonant; not artificially deep
voice.pace: medium-fast in casual conversation; measured under threat
voice.delivery: playful and relaxed; warm and protective with his sister; calm, clipped and controlled in danger

characters.name: 方天豪
characters.canon: 约六十岁，青云方家家主，威猛、强势，对孙子有深厚亲情。

voice.timbre: deep, weighty, mature, slight natural rasp
voice.pace: measured and authoritative; breaks with breath and pauses in grief
voice.delivery: commanding when angry; gentle with grandson's photograph; emotionally fragile when exhausted

characters.name: 方自然
characters.canon: 方自在的妹妹，依赖并信任哥哥，感情细腻；原文描写声音柔和甜美。

voice.timbre: clear, soft, sweet but not childish
voice.delivery: warm and trusting with brother; playful when teasing; restrained sobbing when distressed

characters.name: 秦心
characters.canon: 约二十三四岁，女性警察，英姿飒爽、正直、果断；说话清晰。

voice.pace: brisk and precise in professional mode; warmer in private
voice.delivery: direct and disciplined at work; slight hesitation when emotionally unsettled

characters.name: 顾晓
characters.canon: 大学女生，外表高傲、爱面子，内心敏感且渴望被理解；外貌和发型有明确识别特征。

voice.delivery: self-assured and teasing; vulnerability softens volume and creates hesitation

characters.name: 华凤凤
characters.canon: 性格坚强、直率，面部有明显斜向伤疤，是重要视觉识别特征。

voice.timbre: clear, grounded, slightly husky only when emotionally strained
voice.delivery: direct and guarded; pauses rather than melodramatic crying when recalling trauma

characters.name: 赵欣婉
characters.canon: 银丰公司管理者，受过女子特警训练，豪爽、能干、直率。

voice.delivery: decisive and energetic at work; candid and teasing with friends; visibly concerned when danger strikes

characters.name: 柳如眉
characters.canon: 纤美美容沙龙老板，知性、优雅、温柔且有立场。

voice.delivery: polite and calm; firmness is conveyed through precision rather than volume

characters.name: 唐雅
characters.canon: 鑫源负责人，强势、果断、冷静，有管理能力。

voice.delivery: short direct phrases; rarely raises volume; warmer only with trusted friends

characters.name: 林火
characters.canon: 活泼、直率、火爆，喜欢绘画，表达直接。

voice.delivery: expressive and energetic; softens when apologizing

characters.name: 丛静
characters.canon: 腼腆、温柔、理智、细心，擅长电脑图像处理。

voice.delivery: quiet and thoughtful; slight hesitation without sounding weak

characters.name: 欧阳诗雅
characters.canon: 校园女生，活泼、外向、善于调侃，有模特经历。

voice.delivery: playful, sociable, teasing; brief shy drop in volume when embarrassed

characters.name: 顾老头
characters.canon: 方自在的武术师父，武痴、脾气古怪、爱吹牛，实力深厚。

voice.pace: fast when excited; deliberate when serious
voice.delivery: comic bluster with genuine authority beneath it

characters.name: 天（实验体）
characters.canon: 特殊实验体，语言能力受损，主要出现断续发声和重复词语。

voice.delivery: nonverbal breathing, cries and source-supported fragmented words only; no invented fluent dialogue

characters.name: 泰克
characters.canon: 体格巨大、战斗经验丰富、情绪和自尊心强；原文显示其能听懂普通话但不擅长说普通话。

voice.pace: short forceful phrases; mostly source-supported vocalizations
voice.delivery: restrained menace, frustrated growls, brief source-supported English exclamation

characters.name: 詹姆斯
characters.canon: 泰克之外籍保镖角色，原文提供的声音和性格信息有限。

voice.delivery: professional and observant; do not over-specify until source dialogue provides evidence
